h1: Should I repair or replace my cylinder?
title: Should I repair or replace my cylinder? | G3 Hot-Water Knowledge
description: Understand should i repair or replace my cylinder with clear model-aware information and practical questions for your cylinder engineer.
answer: Compare the identified defect, vessel condition, parts support and installed safety arrangement before choosing repair or replacement.

sections.heading: The key distinction
paragraphs: A serviceable vessel with a failed component can be a repair candidate. A leaking vessel or unsuitable installation can change the decision. The diagnosis should explain why the proposed solution resolves the cause and whether any connected system work is needed.

sections.heading: Apply the information to the installed system
paragraphs: Age is relevant to condition and parts availability, but it is not a diagnosis. For replacement, compare the model, capacity, heating compatibility, access, included controls and handover. Avoid claims that every replacement saves a fixed percentage on bills.

sections.heading: A practical next question
paragraphs: Gather the full model, heating method, recent symptoms and available paperwork. Discuss the scope with a person competent for the actual work. Technical information here supports that conversation and is not a substitute for manufacturer instructions or individual system assessment.

faqs.question: Is cylinder age alone a reliable reason to replace it?
faqs.answer: No. Condition, the actual fault, parts support and installation suitability should guide the decision, alongside age and expected practical service life.
